# SURGICISS LTD

> SURGICISS LTD supplies sterile barrier products, sterile services software and department support for hospitals, surgery centres and sterile services departments.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://surgiciss-clone-master.lovable.app/)
- [Products](https://surgiciss-clone-master.lovable.app/products): tray integrity tests, brush racks, count sheet holders, master wrap, quality assurance cards, monitoring
- [Software](https://surgiciss-clone-master.lovable.app/software): SURGICISS Matrix (AI), Case Cart Matrix, Crash Cart Matrix, Endoscope Matrix
- [Services](https://surgiciss-clone-master.lovable.app/services): management and leadership, morale sessions, technician training
- [Programmes](https://surgiciss-clone-master.lovable.app/programmes): cost reduction, loaner instrument processing, sterile forensics
- [Request a quote](https://surgiciss-clone-master.lovable.app/request-quote)
- [Contact](https://surgiciss-clone-master.lovable.app/contact-us)
